correctness.rationale: The OU Gaussian increments yield exactly the source phase kernel and first-harmonic response; the strict log-concavity proof gives increasing hazard, strict survival submultiplicativity, \(M_0M_2<2M_1^2\), and h prime strictly negative. This proves the unique-root sign structure and all boundary cases. High-rate Watson expansion and inverse-function theorem prove both displayed endpoint laws. Numeric verifier corroborates 61 checks; it is not relied on for the infinite assertions.

value.rationale: The exact existence-only sufficient condition from the motivating recent model leaves open the number and location of competing switching optima. The theorem gives a sharp all-parameter switching landscape, excludes secondary minima and gives quantitative onset/strong-response scales, directly relevant to choosing the operating rate in a spin–phase synchronization model. This is a structural application of a nontrivial moment inequality, not an arbitrary numerical slice or a renaming of the threshold formula.
